items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: It got so we loved each other.

ctx.x: Machinegun McGirt. A little sharp cat. Sharp, about my size, who come down to the theater. He say, "Duke, I had a call, I'm supposed to look out for you guys." And right away he attaches himself to me. I said, "Man, I don't need nobody." And I used to keep this cat out until all hours of the night. And he loved it. It got so we loved each other. Where ever you'd see me, he'd be right there somewhere. He was sharp. And all of them knew him, you know. Years ago at this cafe.
Where's this cafe in Chicago? Mike DeLisa and his brother had a cafe.
